title: huggingface/transformers
title_zh: Transformers: 用于文本、计算机视觉、音频、视频和多模态模型的推理和训练的模型定义框架

paragraphs.en: 🤗 Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, vision, audio, and multimodal models, for both inference and training.
paragraphs.zh: 🤗 Transformers：用于文本、视觉、音频及多模态领域最先进机器学习模型的模型定义框架，同时支持推理与训练。

paragraphs.en: State-of-the-art pretrained models for inference and training
paragraphs.zh: 用于推理和训练的最先进预训练模型

paragraphs.en: Transformers acts as the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning with text, computer vision, audio, video, and multimodal models, for both inference and training.
paragraphs.zh: Transformers 是用于文本、计算机视觉、音频、视频和多模态模型的最先进机器学习的模型定义框架，适用于推理和训练。

paragraphs.en: It centralizes the model definition so that this definition is agreed upon across the ecosystem. transformers is the pivot across frameworks: if a model definition is supported, it will be compatible with the majority of training frameworks (Axolotl, Unsloth, DeepSpeed, FSDP, PyTorch-Lightning, ...), inference engines (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, ...), and adjacent modeling libraries (llama.cpp, mlx, ...) which leverage the model definition from transformers .
paragraphs.zh: 它将模型定义集中化，使这一定义在整个生态系统中得到一致认同。transformers 是各框架之间的枢纽：只要某个模型定义受支持，它就能与绝大多数训练框架（Axolotl、Unsloth、DeepSpeed、FSDP、PyTorch-Lightning 等）、推理引擎（vLLM、SGLang、TGI 等）以及利用 transformers 模型定义的相关建模库（llama.cpp、mlx 等）兼容。

paragraphs.en: We pledge to help support new state-of-the-art models and democratize their usage by having their model definition be simple, customizable, and efficient.
paragraphs.zh: 我们承诺帮助支持新的最先进模型，并使其模型定义简单、可定制且高效，从而推动其使用的民主化。

paragraphs.en: There are over 1M+ Transformers model checkpoints on the Hugging Face Hub you can use.
paragraphs.zh: Hugging Face Hub 上有超过 100 万（1M+）个 Transformers 模型检查点可供你使用。

paragraphs.en: Explore the Hub today to find a model and use Transformers to help you get started right away.
paragraphs.zh: 立即探索 Hub 以寻找模型，并使用 Transformers 帮助您快速上手。

paragraphs.en: Transformers works with Python 3.11+, and PyTorch 2.6+.
paragraphs.zh: Transformers 支持 Python 3.11+ 和 PyTorch 2.6+。

paragraphs.en: Create and activate a virtual environment with venv or uv , a fast Rust-based Python package and project manager.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 venv 或 uv（一个快速的基于 Rust 的 Python 包与项目管理器）创建并激活虚拟环境。

paragraphs.en: # venv python - m venv . my - env source . my - env / bin / activate # uv uv venv . my - env source . my - env / bin / activate Install Transformers in your virtual environment.
paragraphs.zh: # venv python - m venv . my - env source . my - env / bin / activate # uv uv venv . my - env source . my - env / bin / activate 在你的虚拟环境中安装 Transformers。

paragraphs.en: # pip pip install "transformers[torch]" # uv uv pip install "transformers[torch]" Install Transformers from source if you want the latest changes in the library or are interested in contributing. However, the latest version may not be stable. Feel free to open an issue if you encounter an error.
paragraphs.zh: # pip pip install "transformers[torch]" # uv uv pip install "transformers[torch]" 如果你想获取库中的最新更改或有兴趣参与贡献，可以从源代码安装 Transformers。 但是，最新版本可能不稳定。 如果遇到错误，欢迎随时提交 issue。

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.git cd transformers # pip pip install ' .[torch] ' # uv uv pip install ' .[torch] ' Quickstart Get started with Transformers right away with the Pipeline API. The Pipeline is a high-level inference class that supports text, audio, vision, and multimodal tasks. It handles preprocessing the input and returns the appropriate output.
paragraphs.zh: git clone https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.git cd transformers # pip pip install ' .[torch] ' # uv uv pip install ' .[torch] ' 快速入门 通过 Pipeline API 立即开始使用 Transformers。 Pipeline 是一个支持文本、音频、视觉和多模态任务的高级推理类。 它负责对输入进行预处理，并返回相应的输出。

sents.en: git clone https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.git cd transformers # pip pip install ' .[torch] ' # uv uv pip install ' .[torch] ' Quickstart Get started with Transformers right away with the Pipeline API.
sents.zh: git clone https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.git cd transformers # pip pip install ' .[torch] ' # uv uv pip install ' .[torch] ' 快速入门 通过 Pipeline API 立即开始使用 Transformers。

sents.en: The Pipeline is a high-level inference class that supports text, audio, vision, and multimodal tasks.
sents.zh: Pipeline 是一个支持文本、音频、视觉和多模态任务的高级推理类。

sents.en: It handles preprocessing the input and returns the appropriate output.
sents.zh: 它负责对输入进行预处理，并返回相应的输出。

paragraphs.en: Instantiate a pipeline and specify model to use for text generation. The model is downloaded and cached so you can easily reuse it again. Finally, pass some text to prompt the model.
paragraphs.zh: 实例化一个流水线，并指定用于文本生成的模型。 该模型会被下载并缓存，因此你可以轻松地再次复用它。 最后，传入一些文本作为提示来驱动该模型。

sents.en: Instantiate a pipeline and specify model to use for text generation.
sents.zh: 实例化一个流水线，并指定用于文本生成的模型。

sents.en: The model is downloaded and cached so you can easily reuse it again.
sents.zh: 该模型会被下载并缓存，因此你可以轻松地再次复用它。

sents.en: Finally, pass some text to prompt the model.
sents.zh: 最后，传入一些文本作为提示来驱动该模型。

paragraphs.en: from transformers import pipeline pipeline = pipeline ( task = "text-generation" , model = "Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B" ) pipeline ( "the secret to baking a really good cake is " ) [{ 'generated_text' : 'the secret to baking a really good cake is 1) to use the right ingredients and 2) to follow the recipe exactly. the recipe for the cake is as follows: 1 cup of sugar, 1 cup of flour, 1 cup of milk, 1 cup of butter, 1 cup of eggs, 1 cup of chocolate chips. if you want to make 2 cakes, how much sugar do you need? To make 2 cakes, you will need 2 cups of sugar.' }] To chat with a model, the usage pattern is the same. The only difference is you need to construct a chat history (the input to Pipeline ) between you and the system.
paragraphs.zh: from transformers import pipeline pipeline = pipeline ( task = "text-generation" , model = "Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B" ) pipeline ( "the secret to baking a really good cake is " ) [{ 'generated_text' : 'the secret to baking a really good cake is 1) to use the right ingredients and 2) to follow the recipe exactly. the recipe for the cake is as follows: 1 cup of sugar, 1 cup of flour, 1 cup of milk, 1 cup of butter, 1 cup of eggs, 1 cup of chocolate chips. if you want to make 2 cakes, how much sugar do you need? 要做 2 个蛋糕，你需要 2 杯糖。'}] 要与模型聊天，使用模式是一样的。 唯一的区别是你需要在 你和系统之间构建一个聊天历史（即 Pipeline 的输入）。

paragraphs.en: You can also chat with a model directly from the command line, as long as transformers serve is running .
paragraphs.zh: 你也可以直接在命令行中与模型对话，只要 transformers serve 正在运行即可。

paragraphs.en: transformers chat Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct import torch from transformers import pipeline chat = [ { "role" : "system" , "content" : "You are a sassy, wise-cracking robot as imagined by Hollywood circa 1986." }, { "role" : "user" , "content" : "Hey, can you tell me any fun things to do in New York?" } ] pipeline = pipeline ( task = "text-generation" , model = "meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct" , dtype = torch . bfloat16 , device_map = "auto" ) response = pipeline ( chat , max_new_tokens = 512 ) print ( response [ 0 ][ "generated_text" ][ - 1 ][ "content" ]) Expand the examples below to see how Pipeline works for different modalities and tasks.
paragraphs.zh: transformers chat Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct import torch from transformers import pipeline chat = [ { "role" : "system" , "content" : "You are a sassy, wise-cracking robot as imagined by Hollywood circa 1986." }, { "role" : "user" , "content" : "Hey, can you tell me any fun things to do in New York?" } ] pipeline = pipeline ( task = "text-generation" , model = "meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct" , dtype = torch . bfloat16 , device_map = "auto" ) response = pipeline ( chat , max_new_tokens = 512 ) print ( response [ 0 ][ "generated_text" ][ - 1 ][ "content" ]) 展开下方示例，查看 Pipeline 在不同模态和任务中的工作方式。

paragraphs.en: from transformers import pipeline pipeline = pipeline ( task = "automatic-speech-recognition" , model = "openai/whisper-large-v3" ) pipeline ( "https://huggingface.co/datasets/Narsil/asr_dummy/resolve/main/mlk.flac" ) { 'text' : ' I have a dream that one day this nation will rise up and live out the true meaning of its creed.' } Image classification from transformers import pipeline pipeline = pipeline ( task = "image-classification" , model = "facebook/dinov2-small-imagenet1k-1-layer" ) pipeline ( "https://huggingface.co/datasets/Narsil/image_dummy/raw/main/parrots.png" ) [{ 'label' : 'macaw' , 'score' : 0.997848391532898 }, { 'label' : 'sulphur-crested cockatoo, Kakatoe galerita, Cacatua galerita' , 'score' : 0.0016551691805943847 }, { 'label' : 'lorikeet' , 'score' : 0.00018523589824326336 }, { 'label' : 'African grey, African gray, Psittacus erithacus' , 'score' : 7.85409429227002e-05 }, { 'label' : 'quail' , 'score' : 5.502637941390276e-05 }] Visual question answering from transformers import pipeline pipeline = pipeline ( task = "visual-question-answering" , model = "Salesforce/blip-vqa-base" ) pipeline ( image = "https://huggingface.co/datasets/huggingface/documentation-images/resolve/main/transformers/tasks/idefics-few-shot.jpg" , question = "What is in the image?" , ) [{ 'answer' : 'statue of liberty' }] Why should I use Transformers? paragraphs.en: Transformers is more than a toolkit to use pretrained models, it's a community of projects built around it and the Hugging Face Hub. We want Transformers to enable developers, researchers, students, professors, engineers, and anyone else to build their dream projects.
paragraphs.zh: Transformers 不仅仅是一个使用预训练模型的工具包，它还是一个围绕它和 Hugging Face Hub 构建的项目社区。 我们希望 Transformers 能够帮助开发者、研究人员、学生、教授、工程师以及任何其他人构建他们的梦想项目。

sents.en: We want Transformers to enable developers, researchers, students, professors, engineers, and anyone else to build their dream projects.
sents.zh: 我们希望 Transformers 能够帮助开发者、研究人员、学生、教授、工程师以及任何其他人构建他们的梦想项目。

paragraphs.en: In order to celebrate Transformers 100,000 stars, we wanted to put the spotlight on the community with the awesome-transformers page which lists 100 incredible projects built with Transformers.
paragraphs.zh: 为了庆祝 Transformers 获得 100,000 星标，我们想通过 awesome-transformers 页面将焦点放在社区上，该页面列出了 100 个使用 Transformers 构建的出色项目。

paragraphs.en: If you own or use a project that you believe should be part of the list, please open a PR to add it!
paragraphs.zh: 如果您拥有或使用某个您认为应被收录进该列表的项目，请提交 PR 将其添加进来！
